WITH reaped AS (
           UPDATE jobs
            SET
                status = 'Queued',
                worker_id = NULL,
                lock_token = NULL,
                heartbeat_at = NULL
                WHERE
                    status = 'Running'
                    AND heartbeat_at < NOW() - ($1 * INTERVAL '1 seconds')
                    RETURNING id
            )
           INSERT INTO job_outbox (
                id,
                job_id,
                event_type
           )
           SELECT
               gen_random_uuid(),
               id,
               'job.execute'
           FROM reaped
           RETURNING job_id
